title: Starving for oxygen waiting on rain washing pain forgetting my name in sounds found in drumming of the sun as yesterdays collapse into tomrrow's haze
summary: Starving for oxygen waiting on rain washing pain forgetting my name in sounds found in drumming of the sun as yesterdays collapse into tomrrow's haze #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Starving for oxygen
  waiting on rain
washing pain
forgetting my name
in sounds found in
drumming of the sun
as yesterdays collapse
into tomrrow's haze
#smallpoems
